notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no block/WAF, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Magento storefront with Searchspring (siteId 'nhbtv0') powering all category/PLP listings via JS widget (div#searchspring-content) — raw HTML has no static product grid or toolbar count, so qty was verified via Searchspring's own search.json API (https://nhbtv0.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json?siteId=nhbtv0&bgfilter.ss_categories=<name>), the exact same source the storefront JS calls to render each page; each page's own ss_categories name/id was read from its embedded 'searchspring-context' script tag (not guessed) before querying, and totalResults was cross-checked stable across resultsPerPage=1/100/250. Full exhaustion fetch (24/24 unique IDs) done for Homewares>Decorative as an extra check; result matched API's reported total exactly. Rule 0 gains: this is a lighting specialist so nearly the whole in-scope catalogue is Lighting (63 leaf rows across ~4700 raw qty-units, heavily overlapping — see below); traversed every lighting branch with no depth limit including bathroom (mirrors + vanity/wall lights + IP-rated + modular Chameleon/MFL systems), outdoor (garden/deck/security/solar/coastal/12V/240V/step/festoon), DIY (garden batten-fix), Smart Lighting fixtures, and the two 'Create Your Own' modular component pages (Pendant shades/hardware qty 141, Chameleon bathroom sconce fascias qty 12) which are genuine sellable product listings, not configurator tools. All mirrors captured (Bathroom Mirrors with Lights 32, Bathroom Mirrors [unlit] 29, plus 1 Haus & Co Round Mirror inside Homewares Decorative). Rule 0.6 overlap: site has BOTH a full type tree (Lighting>Pendant/Downlights/Lamps/Bathroom Lighting/Outdoor Lighting/etc, nav-2) AND a room tree (SHOP BY ROOM>Kitchen/Dining/Living Room/Bedroom/Bathroom, nav-10) that re-lists many of the SAME physical SKUs under a room lens (e.g. a pendant counted once under 'Pendant Lighting > Single Pendant Lights' and again under 'Kitchen > Kitchen Pendants'). Per brief both trees are emitted in full (documented here, not deduplicated/subtracted). Within Outdoor Lighting, 'Coastal-Rated Outdoor Lighting' (294), '240V Outdoor Lighting' (139) and '12V Quick Connect Lighting' (71) are rating/voltage-based site-menu entries whose product sets likely overlap with the physical-type siblings (Garden/Deck/Security Lighting) above; included as-is because the site itself presents them as first-class nav-2 entries, not query-string facets. Within Homewares, 3 SKUs are shared between 'Decorative Accessories' and 'Candles & Accessories' (see per-row evidence). Genuine facet re-cuts DROPPED (not rows): 'LED Lights' top-nav (LED Lamps/LED Downlights/LED Pendants — pure technology re-slice of the already-counted Lamps/Downlights/Pendant Lighting branches), 'Dimmable Lamps' (attribute re-cut of Lamps), pendant 'Shop by Material' branch (Rattan/Timber/Glass/Metal/Concrete/Fabric Pendant Lights — material re-cut of Pendant Lighting), 'Style' room sub-branch (Hamptons/Coastal/Contemporary/Luxe/Classic/Industrial — style-tag re-cut across the whole catalogue, ss_categories counts in the hundreds each). Top-nav shortcuts 'Outdoor', 'PENDANTS', 'LAMPS' link to the exact same URLs already captured under the Lighting type-tree branches above — not re-emitted as separate rows (Rule 0.6 'exact same listing under a second URL'). 'Home Office' room dropped: its only two children are 'Best Selling Floor Lamps' / 'Best Selling Task Lamps' curated merchandising lists (NEVER EXTRACT: Best Sellers). Excluded categories entirely: FANS (ceiling/DC/pedestal fans — excluded product type), GLOBES (bulbs — excluded), ELECTRICAL/wholesale-electric-supply (switches, powerpoints, dimmers, LED drivers, smoke alarms, extension leads — wiring hardware), CLEARANCE (sale section, NEVER EXTRACT), INSPIRATION (blog/buying guides/showroom content, NEVER EXTRACT), NEW (new-arrivals merchandising, NEVER EXTRACT), Bathroom Lighting>Heaters & Exhaust, room-tree Bathroom>Bathroom Heaters and Exhaust, all *>Fans children (Dining/Living Room/Bedroom Fans), generic 'Accessories' nodes (lighting/fan/switch accessories — hardware, not decor), Homewares>Brands (brand listing, NEVER EXTRACT), Homewares>Cleaning. No duplicate-company flag applies to S.N. 204 (first Beacon Lighting entry in this project).
